svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a wide capped stack stands on the oxide-filled trench and a narrow capped gate on the right-hand active area, each with a block of nitride against its sidewalls. After it resist covers the whole slice except a window over the wide stack and its sidewall blocks.
